canonical_statement: The review aimed to synthesize available randomized-trial data on the association between anti-diabetic drugs and fracture risk in patients with type 2 diabetes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: our study aimed to analyze all available data on the effects of anti-diabetic drugs on fracture risk in type 2 diabetes mellitus

canonical_statement: The authors searched Embase, Medline, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Cochrane CENTRAL for randomized controlled trials through May 1, 2021, with an English-language restriction.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Embase, Medline, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Cochrane CENTRAL to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) up to May 1, 2021, with English-language restriction.

canonical_statement: Eligible trials were randomized controlled trials lasting at least 12 months, comparing specified anti-diabetic drugs or placebo, with fracture data available.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 1) RCTs; 2) duration ≥12 months; 3) the intervention or comparators were with anti-diabetic drugs; 4) data on fracture were available.

population.label: Randomized controlled trials in type 2 diabetes with fracture data and duration at least 12 months

canonical_statement: Two reviewers independently extracted eligible-study data; disagreements were resolved by review and senior consultation, Cochrane risk-of-bias assessment was used, and GRADE assessed fracture-outcome evidence quality.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: data were extracted by two reviewers independently; the disagreements were resolved by two reviewers and, if necessary, consulted by a senior reviewer

canonical_statement: The network meta-analysis used a Bayesian random-effects model with Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling, four chains of 100,000 iterations each, and risk ratios with 95% confidence intervals.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: posterior distributions of the parameters model were generated by four chains (100,000 per chain, 400,000 iterations) in the random-effects model

canonical_statement: The authors assessed heterogeneity with I2, model fit by residual deviance, inconsistency by node splitting, ranking probabilities, meta-regression, sensitivity analysis, and publication bias with comparison-adjusted funnel plots.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: calculated inconsistency of the direct and indirect comparisons by operating node-splitting method
